text:
lia (prod): quick sync — Acme reported intermittent 5xxs on their private deployment after launch and asked for P99 latency improvements. we need to pick a path: prioritize a bugfix/hotpatch for the 5xxs or schedule an enhancement workstream for latency optimizations?
omar (cs): they saw spikes during mid-afternoon traffic. pretty urgent on SLA side — legal is asking for timeline. customer wants mitigation within 2 weeks.
samir (eng): can you paste logs? is it a traffic pattern or a specific endpoint?
lia (prod): pasted from their support bundle: ````
[2026-03-10T15:12:03Z] request_id=67a2 user=acme-app status=502 backend=serve-1 kv_cache_error=timeout
[2026-03-10T15:12:03Z] request_id=67a3 user=acme-app status=200 backend=serve-2 latency_ms=120
````
jess (eng-ml): looks like a KV cache timeout path, not pure model slowness. P99 could be improved by tuning cache TTLs + failover behavior. that’s an enhancement but also a bug if timeouts are unexpected.
matt (eng-platform): we have a quick mitigation: roll out stricter circuit-breaker to the private control plane so we fall back to a healthy backend faster. small change, low risk. can ship as a canary.
samir (eng): estimate: hotpatch circuit-breaker + monitoring -> 2 days. Root cause fix (KV client resilience) -> 2 sprints. Latency optimization (quant/ batching improvements) -> 3+ sprints.
omar (cs): Acme will accept a short-term mitigation if we promise a roadmap for full fix. need an owner + comms.
lia (prod): proposal: 1) immediate: matt -> canary circuit-breaker rollout this week (owner: matt). 2) next sprint: samir/jess investigate KV client timeouts + reliability fix (owner: samir). 3) Q2: latency optimization workstream (batching + cache-aware routing) for sustained P99 gains.
samir (eng): agree. assign me and jess for the root cause. will create tickets.
jess (eng-ml): will add perf tests to reproduce the spike and add perf regression gates.
matt (eng-platform): canary ready, will run on 10% of Acme traffic then 50%. release-bot: deploy job queued -> job/1849000001.
omar (cs): I'll tell Acme we have a mitigation canary this week and a targeted fix in the next sprint. please share ETA when jobs are queued.
lia (prod): ok decision: prioritize short hotpatch + reliability bugfix next sprint, deprioritize larger latency refactor to Q2. owners: matt (mitigation), samir (reliability), jess (perf tests). Lia will own comms.
samir (eng): creating two tickets: BUG-1938 (KV timeouts) and CHORE-2741 (circuit-breaker canary). ETA for BUG-1938 initial triage: 48h.
jess (eng-ml): adding test vectors + perf harness to BUG-1938. will link evals.
lia (prod): acceptance criteria for the hotpatch: 1) canary shows no 5xx for 48h at 10% traffic 2) alerting on kv_cache_error rate < 0.1% for Acme. for the reliability fix: root cause analysis and a patch that reduces timeouts under load to <1%.
omar (cs): noted. I'll draft the customer message and loop legal if timeline slips. :thumbsup:
samir (eng): quick question — do we need a blameless postmortem if we hit >1% 5xx?
lia (prod): yes, if SLA breached >1% for >1h we do incident review. include in comms.
matt (eng-platform): starting canary now. will post status updates in this thread.
release-bot: deployment started: job/1849000001 -> canary to acme-private-01 (10%).
matt (eng-platform): canary 10% healthy after 30m. metrics look stable.
samir (eng): great — I'll start triage. assigning reviewers.
lia (prod): thanks team. recap: mitigation rolling, triage underway, full latency workmapped to Q2. follow-ups: samir to post triage notes, matt to confirm canary progression, omar to own customer comms.
omar (cs): will send customer update in the next hour.
lia (prod): closing loop — add these tickets to next sprint planning board (sprint-37).
